Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 80
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 12293 of 2022
Applicant :- Rajai @ Rajai Sharma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Prakash Mishra, Prakash Sharma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 313 of 2019, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali Padrauna, District Kushinagar.
Facts in brief are that an F.I.R. was lodged against the applicant in Case Crime No. 313 of 2019 under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and after investigation charge sheet was submitted on 12.01.2021.

During investigation, applicant was on anticipatory bail and after submission of charge sheet summons and B.W. was issued by the learned Court against the applicant which was served on him personally, as a result, he filed personal bond but later on he did no appear before the learned Court Rajai @ Rajai Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163478366/
1 of C.J.M, as a result, N.B.W. was issued against him so this anticipatory bail application is before this Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in this case applicant had no knowledge of process of the Court that was the reason he could not attend the Court concerned.
It is also submitted that applicant is ready to appear before the learned Court to face the trial but being N.B.W. issued against him he is under apprehension of imminent arrest.

In case, the applicant is released on bail, he would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial,
therefore, requested for anticipatory bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, it appears that after submission of charge sheet, summons/ B.W. was personally served to the applicant as shown in the rejection order passed by the learned Court of Session by order dated 13.10.2022.
He also executed personal bond but later on he failed to appear, that was the reason N.B.W. was issued against him.
Keeping in view all the facts and circumstances of the case, there appears no ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of the applicant.
Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application is, hereby, rejected.

However, if applicant appears and moves bail/recall application before the learned Court concerned,
it shall be heard and disposed of as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Suraj Srivastav  Rajai @ Rajai Sharma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163478366/
